name: CSO_CONTENT_TEXT_PROD
description: This table stores mapping of article and products.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to content text table record.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: The inventory item assigned to article.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: The organization of the inventory item assigned to article.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B (PROD_GROUP_ID), the product group that the product belongs in.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: This column indicates if product or product group is associated.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
